task_completion.description: Firefox Developer Tools is open and the Network tab is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox DevTools pane is visible at the bottom or side of the browser, with the 'Network' tab highlighted.

task_completion.description: The 'Sync CRM Telemetry' button is clicked, resulting in a failed 400 Bad Request.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A POST request to /api/v1/telemetry/sync appears in the Network log with a status code of 400.

task_completion.description: The 'Edit and Resend' interface is opened for the failed request.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'New Request' or 'Edit and Resend' pane appears in DevTools, showing editable headers and body for the telemetry sync endpoint.

task_completion.description: The JSON payload is modified to fix the 'bidirectional' typo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the request body editor, the text '"mode": "bidirectional"' is visible (corrected from 'bidirectonal').

task_completion.description: The 'force_refresh' parameter is changed from false to true.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the request body editor, the text '"force_refresh": true' is visible.

task_completion.description: The modified request is sent and returns a 200 OK status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second POST request to /api/v1/telemetry/sync appears in the Network log with a status code of 200.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox DevTools GUI rather than executing curl commands in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the DevTools 'Edit and Resend' panel and the Network log, not a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the specific request generated by the page.
integrity.visual_evidence: The DevTools Network log shows the sequence of the original 400 error followed by the manual edit and the subsequent 200 success.

integrity.description: The agent did not attempt to trigger the API success by navigating directly to the API URL in the address bar.
integrity.visual_evidence: The address bar remains at http://localhost:8080/admin throughout the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires fixing a specific typo ('bidirectonal' -> 'bidirectional') and a boolean toggle ('force_refresh': false -> true) within the Firefox DevTools 'Edit and Resend' feature. A successful completion must show two POST requests to /api/v1/telemetry/sync in the Network tab: the first with a 400 status and the second with a 200 status.
